title: "Wrangling data"

### **NASA Earthdata Harmony Transformation Services**

Harmony provides access to services that can transform data from NASA's Earthdata Cloud.  Transformation services available may include spatial subsetting, temporal subsetting, variable subsetting, reformatting, and reprojection.  *Not all data have transformation services available and the available services vary by data set.*  Transformations can be requested using one of two Open Geospatial Consortium (OGC) inspired [APIs](https://harmony.earthdata.nasa.gov/docs).

Query the Harmony Capabilities endpoint using the collection concept-ID or short name to determine whether your collection has Harmony services enabled.  Supply the url in a browser or use curl to request the json response in the terminal.
```
https://harmony.earthdata.nasa.gov/capabilities?collectionId=<collection-concept-id>
```
```
https://harmony.earthdata.nasa.gov/capabilities?shortName=<collection-short-name>
```
**Example**

SMAP L2 Radar Half-Orbit 3 km EASE-Grid Soil Moisture. (SPL2SMA, Version 3) = C2812935277-NSIDC_CPRD

Query the capabilities endpoint using the concept-id for the data set.
```
https://harmony.earthdata.nasa.gov/capabilities?collectionId=C2812935277-NSIDC_CPRD
```
You'll get back a JSON response containing information about transformation services available. 
```
{
  "conceptId": "C2812935277-NSIDC_CPRD",
  "shortName": "SPL2SMA",
  "summary": {
    "subsetting": {
      "bbox": true,
      "dimension": false,
      "shape": true,
      "temporal": false,
      "variable": true
    },
    "reprojection": {
      "supported": true,
      "supportedProjections": [],
      "interpolationMethods": []
    },
    "averaging": {
      "time": false,
      "area": false
    },
    "concatenation": false,
    "outputFormats": [
      {
        "name": "GEOTIFF",
        "mimeType": "image/tiff"
      },
      {
        "name": "HDF",
        "mimeType": "application/x-hdf"
      },
      {
        "name": "NETCDF-4",
        "mimeType": "application/netcdf"
      }
    ]
  }
```


Harmony documentation can be found [here](https://harmony.earthdata.nasa.gov/docs).

You can use the Harmony APIs and endpoints to interact with Harmony [directly](https://nsidc.org/data/user-resources/help-center/harmony-api-quickstart-guide-customizing-nasa-nsidc-daac-data-earthdata-cloud). The [`harmony-py`](https://github.com/nasa/harmony-py) Python library is the recommended option for Python users.
